details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It ships a 1.6KB beacon (beacon.cjs) that runs from a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") and again whenever index.js is required, sending an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an x-beacon-package header. The JSON body contains only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory and the node version string. No environment variables, credentials, tokens or file contents are read or transmitted, and no further payload is downloaded or executed. index.js exports a catch-all Proxy shim so that builds importing the package name complete instead of failing. The package is published under a scoped name at version 99.0.1 with a near-empty tarball, the classic dependency-confusion placeholder shape, and its README describes it as an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports that it was installed.
